mapper.sql: p.id, p.name, p.client_org_id, p.type, p.description, p.start_date, p.end_date, p.current_stage, p.status, p.created_at, o.name AS client_org_name
mapper.select: SELECT FROM project p JOIN client_org o ON o.id = p.client_org_id WHERE p.id = #{id}
SELECT FROM project p JOIN client_org o ON o.id = p.client_org_id JOIN project_member m ON m.project_id = p.id WHERE m.account_id = #{accountId} AND m.left_at IS NULL ORDER BY p.created_at DESC
SELECT FROM project p JOIN client_org o ON o.id = p.client_org_id ORDER BY p.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project (name, client_org_id, type, description, start_date, end_date, current_stage, status) VALUES (#{name}, #{clientOrgId}, #{type}, #{description}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, COALESCE(#{currentStage}, 1), COALESCE(#{status}, 'active'))
mapper.update: UPDATE project SET current_stage = GREATEST(current_stage, #{stage}) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE project SET status = 'completed', current_stage = 24 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE project SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
